subject: [PATCH 3/6] kernfs: don't take kernfs_iattr_rwsem for the directory counters

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch removes the unnecessary locking of kernfs_iattr_rwsem in kernfs_link_sibling and kernfs_unlink_sibling functions, which are responsible for updating directory counters. The lock was previously taken to ensure that link counts were stable during getattr operations, but this is no longer necessary as the link count is now read from the node instead of being copied. The patch also marks the accesses with WRITE_ONCE to ensure atomicity and asserts that kernfs_rwsem is held. This change improves performance by reducing contention between writers under load.
